sense: a function, the part someone plays

evidence: Cic. Fam. 11.5.3: tuum est hoc mūnus, tuae partēs
Cic. de Or. 2.26: Antōniī audiō esse partēs, ut dē tōtā ēloquentiā disserat (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Plural. “It’s your job to …” is tuum est, or tuae partēs sunt with ut.

evidence: Cic. Off. 1.20: jūstitiae prīmum mūnus est ut nē cui quis noceat
terms.comment: The task that falls to someone or something.

terms.gloss: the part one plays in life
evidence: Cic. de Or. 2.194: neque āctor sim aliēnae persōnae, sed auctor meae (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The character or part a person sustains.

phrases.latin: tuum est hoc mūnus, tuae partēs, ā tē hoc cīvitās vel omnēs potius gentēs nōn exspectant sōlum sed etiam postulant
phrases.english: this is your task, your role: the state, or rather all nations, not only expect it of you but demand it

phrases.latin: jūstitiae prīmum mūnus est ut nē cui quis noceat nisi lacessītus injūriā
phrases.english: the first role of justice is that no one should harm another unless provoked by a wrong

sources: Lewis & Short: pars · Lewis & Short: munus · Lewis & Short: persona
